caseName: Powers v. Scott County Milling Co.
caseNameFull: Neely Powers, Trustee, etc. v. Scott County Milling Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Mississippi.
attorneys: Mr. James N. Flowers and Mr. William 11. Watkins for plaintiff in error. Mr. Robert H. Thompson and Mr. George Butler for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
